invariants: Preserve source identity, version, query and units; historical evidence never grants fresh-read or mutation authority.
Commit each returned pair once; preserve unknown outcomes and existing off/warn/pause choices.
Exactly measured model input and one batch reservation ledger remain authoritative.
existing: EvidenceManager owns once-per-round observations in research and recovery.
Checkpoint and input availability consume unit-bearing range algebra from evidence-ranges.js.
doNotDuplicate: No second source identity calculator, coverage ledger, progress planner, or archive store.
Do not call recovery observation separately after normal research has already ingested that round.
Use ExecutionState and existing delivery flow for policy actions.
impactedSurfaces: CommonJS range module extracted from existing operations
Compactor continuity, progress, input and recovery tests
validationPlan: Byte/line partial/full/empty/version fixtures survive checkpoint and restore without invented completeness.
A/B and A/B/C loops recognized; advancing pages, changed versions and necessary fresh reads remain allowed.
One ingestion per round in research/recovery; bounded retention eviction becomes unknown.
Old missing fields decode conservatively; derived legacy fields cannot become competing writers.
